brief:
Gaza held funeral processions for 100 bodies from three families, the Ma'an news agency reported. Residents gathered to lay the dead to rest as mourners moved through the streets in what marked a major collective burial in the territory.

The identities of the families and the specific circumstances of the deaths were not immediately disclosed. No additional details about when the funerals took place or the locations of the burial sites were available at the time of reporting.
title: Gaza buries hundred martyrs from three families
